title: aidd eval held-out lock
description: The format of evals/held-out.lock.json: one entry for each eval case whose `tier` is `held-out`. A held-out case is read once, at a release, and never tuned against. The entry holds a hash of the case's content, and the date its score was first read, or null before that. A case whose content differs from its hash after the first read date fails a test.

cases.description: One entry for each held-out case, sorted by suite, then case.

suite.description: The suite that holds the case.

case.description: The case's id (routing, roles) or its folder name (plugin, team).

content_sha256.description: A SHA-256 over the whole case: its fields, or every file of its folder.

first_read_on.description: The UTC date a run first scored the case, or null while it is unread.
